description: This Java source file defines a utility class 'WaitUtils' for centralized, reusable wait operations in Selenium-based UI testing. It provides methods for explicit waits on elements, URL, page readiness, spinners, custom conditions, and includes retry logic for stale element exceptions.

classes.name: WaitUtils
classes.description: A final utility class providing centralized wait operations for Selenium WebDriver tests, supporting explicit, implicit, and custom waits, with logging and retry capabilities.

methods.name: defaultWait
methods.description: Creates a WebDriverWait with default timeout.

methods.name: waitFor
methods.description: Creates a WebDriverWait with a specified custom timeout.

methods.name: fluentWait
methods.description: Creates a FluentWait configured with polling interval and exception ignoring.

methods.name: forVisible
methods.description: Waits until an element located by the given locator is visible, using default or custom timeout.

methods.name: forClickable
methods.description: Waits until the element is clickable.

methods.name: forPresence
methods.description: Waits for the presence of an element in the DOM.

methods.name: forInvisible
methods.description: Waits for an element to become invisible, returns false if timeout occurs.

methods.name: forUrlContains
methods.description: Waits until the URL contains a specific fragment.

methods.name: forPageReady
methods.description: Waits until the page's document.readyState is 'complete'.

methods.name: forSpinnerToDisappear
methods.description: Waits for the loading spinner to disappear.

methods.name: forCondition
methods.description: Polls a custom boolean condition, waiting until true or timeout.

methods.name: forConditionSafe
methods.description: Polls a custom boolean condition, returns false on timeout instead of throwing.

methods.name: retryOnStale
methods.description: Retries an action up to maximum retries if StaleElementReferenceException is raised.
